tz: dates are in the ad account timezone as returned by Meta
note: Per-ad DAILY time series over the 7-day window (including today), keyed by SKU extracted from ad names (e.g. 'H-1920'); an ad mentioning several SKUs appears under each. Each ad carries a 'daily' list — one row per date with delivery (missing date = zero delivery), like campaigns.json. purchases = Meta action type 'omni_purchase' (fallback 'purchase') — the Ads Manager Purchases column; null when zero. frequency is Meta's own daily value (fallback impressions/reach; null when reach=0). cpmUSD/ctrPct/clicks/impressions/reach straight from the Insights API. Built for trend detection (rising CPM, collapsing CTR, ...). error!=null means the fetch failed — campaigns.json and ads-7d.json are unaffected.
